aiModelsTab.apiKeysIntro: Your org's own API key for each vendor, used for AI-assisted operations assigned to that vendor. If unset for a vendor, the deployment's default key is used. Keys are never shown once saved. You may paste a vault reference instead of the key itself — ${secret:NAME} is resolved against your org's secrets each time it is used.
aiModelsTab.apiKeyNotSet: No key set — using deployment default
aiModelsTab.apiKeyWillClear: The key will be cleared when you save.
aiModelsTab.modelsIntro: Vendor and model used for each AI-assisted operation. Vendor accepts any aisuite-supported name (e.g. anthropic, openai, ollama for a local model). Leave the model blank to reset that operation to the default.
aiModelsTab.nlIntro: Requests per minute per role for NL-to-SQL. Leave empty for unlimited.
aiModelsTab.vectorIntro: Registered embedding models available for semantic search. The registry is an allowlist.
aiModelsTab.endpointsIntro: Point a role assignment's vendor at a self-hosted or third-party gateway (e.g. OpenRouter, LiteLLM, an internal proxy) that isn't one of the named vendors above. Style selects which wire protocol the base URL speaks. Enter this endpoint's id as the vendor for any role assignment above.
aiModelsTab.jevIntro: Optional. When set, Provisa uses Jev's calibrated-confidence decision API to score glossary relationship-type proposals and discovered foreign-key relationships, instead of relying only on the generating model's self-reported confidence. If unset, those features fall back to their existing model-only behavior. If unset here, the deployment's TYPESAFEAI_API_KEY env var is used when present.
aiModelsTab.savedRestartRequired: Saved. Restart the service to apply.
